summary: Iteration 13 — Monetization / entitlements / cost control end-to-end. Backend 20/20 PASSED against the public preview URL as the seeded montest.user@decisivlabs.dev account: (1) GET /api/billing/status returns plan=free, state=free, billing_enabled=false and the full features map (audio_minutes, ai_import, import_pages, memory_question, ai_briefing) each with used/allowance/remaining/pct plus a product block (product_id/monthly_base_plan_id/annual_base_plan_id/package_name); (2) GET /api/usage/status returns the same shape; (3) GET /api/plan/config returns free_starter, premium and billing_enabled=false with the correct spec allowances (free 2 imports / 5 memory; premium 300 audio, 100 memory); (4) /api/import metering — imports 1 & 2 consume ai_import(1)+import_pages(1) each and the 3rd returns HTTP 402 with structured detail {error:'limit_reached', feature:'ai_import', consumed:2, allowance:2, reset_date, plan, message}; (5) /api/search metering — a query with no matching content returns 200 early WITHOUT consuming memory_question, then 5 grounded queries fully exhaust the 5-question allowance and the 6th call returns HTTP 402 with detail.feature=='memory_question'; (6) POST /api/billing/google/verify with a fake token returns 503 (BILLING_ENABLED=false) and the plan stays 'free'; (7) POST /api/monetization/event {kind:paywall_impression}=>200 ok, unknown kind =>400; (8) GET /api/admin/monetization and /api/admin/cost-projection both return 403 for the non-admin montest user; (9) Regression clean — /api/tasks, /api/events, /api/briefing, /api/review all 200 AFTER limits are reached and manual POST /api/tasks succeeds (Free is never paywalled). FRONTEND 100%: /diagnostics renders the 'Plan & usage' card with 'Free (Starter Pack)' chip, five usage progress bars (audio minutes, AI imports, imported pages, AI Memory questions, AI Briefings/Reviews) and three action buttons (diag-upgrade/diag-restore/diag-manage). /paywall renders the headline, Annual+Best value + Monthly both visible with 'Price shown at checkout', 'Subscriptions launch soon…' banner, the auto-renew disclosure, testIDs paywall-close/plan-annual/plan-monthly/paywall-subscribe/paywall-restore/paywall-manage. Today screen loads without a paywall and exposes the manual + task FAB.

action_items: No blocking action items — monetization backend + paywall + entitlements are spec-complete for a BILLING_ENABLED=false preview build.

Reminder for main agent: Google Play Billing verification (expo-iap purchase / restore) and real Google-Play RTDN reconciliation are DEVICE-ONLY and cannot be validated from the web preview — mark them as tested only on a signed device build with BILLING_ENABLED=true.
Optional: silence the two RN-Web console warnings ('shadow*' props, 'props.pointerEvents') for a cleaner console — non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: monetization.reserve() correctly uses an atomic conditional $inc ({$or:[{field:{$lte: allowance - amount}}, {field:{$exists:false}}]}) so concurrent reserves cannot exceed allowance — verified with 20-concurrent reserve stress test in test_monetization.py (existing).
monetization.reserve_import() correctly rolls back the ai_import reserve when the import_pages reserve raises, so a page-cap 402 never silently burns an import.

routers/content.py /search returns EARLY when there is no source to ground on and never enters mon.reserve — the 'no consume without grounded answer' contract in the spec is honoured (verified end-to-end).
routers/billing.py billing_verify hard-fails with 503 when BILLING_ENABLED=false BEFORE any Play RPC — client cannot smuggle premium via a manufactured purchase_token.
routers/billing.py _apply_entitlement rejects a purchase_token already bound to a different user_id with 409 — good anti-account-sharing guard.
routers/monetization.py monetization_event uses a hard-coded allow-list of six kinds and 400s on anything else, keeping the funnel dataset clean.
routers/monetization.py _require_admin looks up email in config.ADMIN_EMAILS (currently empty in preview) — safely fails closed with 403 for any real user.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (diagnostics Plan & usage card + paywall UI + Today manual FAB all verified)

seed_data_creation: Uses the pre-seeded montest.user@decisivlabs.dev (via python backend/tests/seed_montest_user.py). Test-suite auto-resets the account's usage_cycles + entitlements + imports + source_docs + chunks + review docs before running (module-level autouse fixture) and re-grants a fresh Starter Pack, so the run is fully idempotent. Two grounded imports are consumed per run (~$0.03 OpenAI cost) plus five grounded /search calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Monetization + entitlements + cost control is green on the preview URL. BILLING_ENABLED=false and ADMIN_EMAILS is empty, so /api/billing/google/verify=503 and /api/admin/* =403 are the correct terminal states. If you need to rerun this suite, either (a) run `python backend/tests/seed_montest_user.py` (idempotent) and let the pytest autouse fixture reset counters, or (b) manually delete `usage_cycles`, `entitlements`, `imports`, `source_docs`, `chunks`, `review` for that user_id. Google Play verification / restore / RTDN are DEVICE-ONLY and MUST NOT be marked passed from web/API tests. The paywall's 'Price shown at checkout' fallback appears whenever expo-iap can't fetch a real Play SKU (i.e., web preview) — that is the expected string, not a bug.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no product bugs found this iteration. One transient test-only issue: the initial version of test_search_grounded_meters_and_exhausts assumed a fresh memory_question counter, but the earlier 'no grounding' probe query semantically matched an existing chunk and consumed one memory_question, causing an off-by-one 402. Fixed by making the grounded burn read the current used/allowance from /api/usage/status and only fire (allowance - used) queries. This confirmed the backend metering is actually TIGHTER than the test originally expected — a good sign.
